WITH r AS (
  SELECT rg.logregistry AS registration_id, rg.arcref AS project_id,
         (rg.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric AS registration_accuracy_mm,
         (rg.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric AS error_value_mm,
         rg.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Method' AS method,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric AS res
  FROM registration rg
  JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = rg.arcref AND p.crewref = rg.crewref
), c AS (
  SELECT *, res / (registration_accuracy_mm * SQRT(1 + error_value_mm / registration_accuracy_mm)) AS rar FROM r
)
SELECT registration_id, project_id, registration_accuracy_mm, error_value_mm,
       ROUND(rar, 2) AS rar,
       CASE WHEN rar > 1.5 AND method LIKE '%Target%' THEN 'High Confidence'
            WHEN rar BETWEEN 1.0 AND 1.5 THEN 'Medium Confidence'
            ELSE 'Low Confidence' END AS confidence_level
FROM c
ORDER BY rar DESC

WITH m AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
         (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric AS faces,
         (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric AS verts,
         (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric AS res,
         (mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::numeric AS geom
  FROM mesh
), mm AS (
  SELECT *, faces / (verts * res * res) * 1000 AS mcr FROM m
), agg AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.zonelabel AS site_name,
         COUNT(mm.zoneref) AS total_meshes,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mm.mcr > 5.0 AND mm.res < 1.0 AND mm.geom < 0.5) AS high_fidelity_meshes,
         AVG(mm.mcr) AS avg_mcr, AVG(mm.res) AS avg_res, AVG(mm.geom) AS avg_geom
  FROM sites s LEFT JOIN mm ON mm.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel
)
SELECT site_code, site_name, total_meshes, high_fidelity_meshes,
       ROUND(high_fidelity_meshes * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_meshes, 0), 2) AS high_fidelity_percentage,
       ROUND(avg_mcr, 2) AS avg_mcr, ROUND(avg_res, 2) AS avg_mesh_resolution_mm,
       ROUND(avg_geom, 2) AS avg_geometric_accuracy_mm,
       CASE WHEN high_fidelity_meshes > 0 THEN 'Has High-Fidelity Meshes'
            WHEN total_meshes > 0 THEN 'Standard Mesh Quality'
            ELSE 'No Mesh Data' END AS mesh_quality_classification
FROM agg
ORDER BY high_fidelity_percentage DESC NULLS LAST

WITH pr AS (
  SELECT e.equipregistry AS equipment_id,
         (p.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::numeric AS hrs,
         (p.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::numeric AS cpu,
         (p.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::numeric AS gpu,
         (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric AS verts,
         NULLIF(regexp_replace(s.size, '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric AS gb
  FROM equipment e
  LEFT JOIN processing p ON p.equipref = e.equipregistry
  LEFT JOIN mesh m ON m.equipref = p.equipref AND m.zoneref = p.zoneref
  LEFT JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = p.zoneref
), agg AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
         AVG(hrs * (cpu + gpu) / 2 / NULLIF(gb * 10 * LOG(10, verts + 10000), 0)) AS pru,
         AVG(hrs) AS avg_hrs, AVG(cpu) AS avg_cpu, AVG(gpu) AS avg_gpu
  FROM pr GROUP BY equipment_id
)
SELECT equipment_id, ROUND(pru, 2) AS pru, ROUND(avg_hrs, 2) AS avg_processing_hours,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pru ASC) AS efficiency_rank,
       CASE WHEN pru < 5.0 THEN 'Optimized'
            WHEN pru <= 10.0 THEN 'Acceptable'
            ELSE 'Needs Optimization' END AS workflow_efficiency_status,
       json_build_object('cpu_usage', ROUND(avg_cpu, 2), 'gpu_usage', ROUND(avg_gpu, 2), 'processing_hours', ROUND(avg_hrs, 2)) AS resource_details
FROM agg
ORDER BY pru ASC

WITH pc AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref, s.arcref, s.crewref,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric AS res,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense')::numeric AS pdense,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric AS cover,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::numeric AS lap,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::numeric AS noise
  FROM scans s JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = s.arcref AND p.crewref = s.crewref
), scan_m AS (
  SELECT zoneref, noise,
         cover * (1 + lap / 100 * (1 - cover / 100)) AS sce,
         POWER(10 / (LOG(10, res * 1000) / LOG(10, pdense) * 5), 1.5)
           * (cover * (1 + lap / 100 * (1 - cover / 100)) / 100)
           * POWER(1 - noise / 30, 2) AS sqs
  FROM pc
), scan_site AS (
  SELECT zoneref, AVG(sqs) AS avg_sqs, AVG(sce) AS avg_sce, AVG(noise) AS avg_noise
  FROM scan_m GROUP BY zoneref
), mesh_m AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
         (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric AS faces,
         (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric AS verts,
         (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric AS mres,
         (mesh_specs->>'Tex_Pix')::numeric AS tex,
         (mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::numeric AS geom
  FROM mesh
), mesh_site AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
         AVG((faces / (verts * mres * mres) * 1000)
             * ((tex / (SQRT(faces) * mres) * 0.01) / 10)
             * (1 + EXP(-geom))) AS avg_mfs
  FROM mesh_m GROUP BY zoneref
), reg_site AS (
  SELECT pc.zoneref,
         AVG(pc.res / ((r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric
             * SQRT(1 + (r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric / (r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric))) AS avg_rar,
         AVG((r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric / pc.res) AS avg_err_ratio
  FROM pc JOIN registration r ON r.arcref = pc.arcref AND r.crewref = pc.crewref
  GROUP BY pc.zoneref
)
SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.zonelabel AS site_name,
       ROUND(
         0.3 * (0.4 * ss.avg_sqs + 0.4 * ms.avg_mfs + 0.2 * ss.avg_sce - 5 * SQRT(ss.avg_noise / 10))
         + 0.3 * ms.avg_mfs + 0.2 * rs.avg_rar + 0.2 * ss.avg_sce
         - 2 * SQRT(rs.avg_err_ratio), 2) AS dpq
FROM sites s
JOIN scan_site ss ON ss.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
JOIN mesh_site ms ON ms.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
JOIN reg_site rs ON rs.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
ORDER BY dpq DESC

SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.zonelabel AS site_name, c.structstate AS structural_state,
       s.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' AS preservation_status,
       CASE WHEN (s.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' LIKE '%Poor%' OR s.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' LIKE '%Critical%')
                 AND c.structstate NOT LIKE '%Stable%'
            THEN 'Degradation Risk Zone' ELSE 'Not in Risk Zone' END AS risk_zone_category
FROM sites s JOIN conservation c ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry

WITH pc AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric AS res,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense')::numeric AS pdense,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric AS cover,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::numeric AS lap,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::numeric AS noise
  FROM scans s JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = s.arcref AND p.crewref = s.crewref
), m AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
         LOG(10, res * 1000) / LOG(10, pdense) * 5 AS sri,
         cover * (1 + lap / 100 * (1 - cover / 100)) AS sce,
         noise
  FROM pc
), q AS (
  SELECT zoneref, POWER(10 / sri, 1.5) * (sce / 100) * POWER(1 - noise / 30, 2) AS sqs FROM m
)
SELECT st.zoneregistry AS site_code, st.zonelabel AS site_name, ROUND(AVG(q.sqs), 2) AS avg_sqs
FROM sites st JOIN q ON q.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
GROUP BY st.zoneregistry, st.zonelabel
ORDER BY avg_sqs DESC

WITH w AS (
  SELECT p.flowregistry, p.flowsoft, p.flowstage,
         (p.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::numeric AS hrs,
         (p.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::numeric AS cpu,
         (p.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::numeric AS gpu,
         NULLIF(regexp_replace(s.size, '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric AS gb,
         (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts')::numeric AS pts
  FROM processing p
  LEFT JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = p.zoneref
  LEFT JOIN pointcloud pc ON pc.arcref = s.arcref AND pc.crewref = s.crewref
), per AS (
  SELECT *, gb * LOG(10, pts) / NULLIF(hrs * (cpu + gpu) / 200, 0) AS per FROM w
), agg AS (
  SELECT flowsoft AS software, flowstage AS stage,
         AVG(hrs) AS avg_hrs, AVG(cpu) AS avg_cpu, AVG(gpu) AS avg_gpu, AVG(gb) AS avg_gb,
         AVG(per) AS avg_per, COUNT(DISTINCT flowregistry) AS workflow_count
  FROM per GROUP BY flowsoft, flowstage
)
SELECT software, stage, ROUND(avg_hrs, 2) AS avg_processing_hours, ROUND(avg_cpu, 2) AS avg_cpu_usage,
       ROUND(avg_gpu, 2) AS avg_gpu_usage, ROUND(avg_gb, 2) AS avg_data_size_gb, ROUND(avg_per, 2) AS avg_per,
       CASE WHEN avg_per < 0.5 THEN 'Bottleneck Detected' ELSE 'Efficient' END AS efficiency_status,
       workflow_count
FROM agg
ORDER BY efficiency_status, avg_per ASC

WITH pc AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts')::numeric / NULLIF((p.cloud_metrics->>'Cloud_Dense')::numeric * (sp.spatial_dims->>'Area_M2')::numeric, 0) AS pcdr,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Cloud_Dense')::numeric AS cloud_dense
  FROM scans s
  JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = s.arcref AND p.crewref = s.crewref
  JOIN spatial sp ON sp.arcref = s.arcref AND sp.crewref = s.crewref
), pcdr_site AS (
  SELECT zoneref, AVG(pcdr) AS avg_pcdr FROM pc GROUP BY zoneref
), fee_site AS (
  SELECT pc.zoneref,
         AVG(((f.feature_analysis->>'Trait_Count')::numeric + (f.feature_analysis->>'Arti_Count')::numeric)
             / NULLIF(pc.pcdr * SQRT(pc.cloud_dense), 0) * 1000) AS avg_fee
  FROM pc JOIN features f ON f.zoneref = pc.zoneref
  GROUP BY pc.zoneref
)
SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, ROUND(ps.avg_pcdr, 2) AS avg_pcdr, ROUND(fs.avg_fee, 2) AS avg_fee
FROM sites s
LEFT JOIN pcdr_site ps ON ps.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
LEFT JOIN fee_site fs ON fs.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
ORDER BY fs.avg_fee DESC NULLS LAST

WITH env AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.zonelabel AS site_name,
         AVG((e.ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::numeric) AS avg_temp,
         AVG((e.ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::numeric) AS avg_humidity,
         AVG((e.ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::numeric) AS avg_illumination,
         AVG(100 - 2.5 * ABS((e.ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::numeric - 20)
             - POWER(ABS(((e.ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::numeric - 50) / 2), 1.5)
             - 600 / ((e.ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::numeric + 100)) AS avg_esi
  FROM sites s JOIN environment e ON e.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel
)
SELECT site_code, site_name,
       ROUND(avg_temp, 1) AS avg_temperature, ROUND(avg_humidity, 1) AS avg_humidity,
       ROUND(avg_illumination, 1) AS avg_illumination, ROUND(avg_esi, 1) AS avg_esi,
       NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY avg_esi) AS esi_quartile,
       CASE WHEN avg_esi > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN avg_esi >= 70 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN avg_esi >= 50 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
            ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions' END AS environmental_condition
FROM env
ORDER BY avg_esi DESC

SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.zonelabel AS site_name,
       ROUND(AVG(100 - 2.5 * ABS((e.ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::numeric - 20)
                 - POWER(ABS(((e.ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::numeric - 50) / 2), 1.5)
                 - 600 / ((e.ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::numeric + 100)), 2) AS avg_esi
FROM sites s JOIN environment e ON e.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel
ORDER BY avg_esi DESC
